Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class Explanation

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Explanation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Commented, Consenting, Sequence, Iterable<Action>
public class Explanation extends Numbered implements Iterable<Action>, Commented, Sequence
An explanation is a plan that a character wants to take at a specific node in a story graph.

If the character for an explanation is null, it represents a plan formed by the story author.

Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • prune

      protected void prune(Predicate<Object> predicate)
      Removes any pruned elements from this element, and if this element itself should be pruned its ID number will be set to Settings.PRUNED.

      An explanation will be pruned if its node, character, or plan have their ID numbers set to Settings.PRUNED.
